newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CNB 13-WK BILL AUCTION YIELD AT 12.20 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CNB 13-WK BILL AUCTION YIELD AT 12.20 PCT.

text.p: The gross yield in Thursday's Czech National Bank (CNB) auction of a five billion crown tranche of 13-week liquidity bills was 12.20 percent, the CNB said.
The gross yield was 12.0 percent in a similar auction on April 10.

The CNB said that the issue was undersubscribed with bids totalling 4.2 billion crowns. Net yield was 9.15 percent, it said. The three-month Prague interbank offered rate (PRIBOR) stood at 12.19 percent on Thursday, unchanged from Wednesday.
